summary: This survey organizes LLM agents around construction, collaboration, and evolution, providing a broad methodology-focused map of the agent field.
why_it_matters: It is a useful general anchor for the vault because it connects agent profile design, memory, planning, action, collaboration, and evolution in one framework.
method_setup: The paper develops a build-collaborate-evolve taxonomy, surveys agent components and collaboration paradigms, and reviews applications together with security, privacy, and ethics challenges.
key_claims: LLM agents should be analyzed through methodology and architecture, not only by application area.
Construction, collaboration, and evolution are the key dimensions for organizing agent systems.
Real-world deployment requires stronger treatment of safety, privacy, and reliability.
limitations: The survey is broad and therefore less detailed on any one subfield.
Its taxonomy is descriptive rather than experimentally benchmarked.
